POSE 1: OK. Feet on base, spine straight, limbs balanced.
POSE 2: ISSUE. Crossed legs unstable, torso twisted, arms asymmetrical.
POSE 3: ISSUE. Leaning back excessively, feet off ground, balance lost.
POSE 4: ISSUE. Spine severely twisted, arm behind back unnatural, stance awkward.
POSE 5: ISSUE. Legs crossed tightly, leaning sideways, poor base of support.
POSE 6: OK. Upright posture, feet on base, limbs relaxed and aligned.
